items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Faye, his wife said they would have to do this Nazi salute when they were kids.

ctx.x: Hmm. Okay. Well, let’s take a break. ……….Break Kimery: We are going.

Anyway, just quickly, Joseph… originally, he was from… his family were not from Germany, originally, ‘cause their last name was Janik, J-A-N-I-K. But he, his family had been hiding Jewish people in their building and they were found out, and his dad was sent to the Russian front and never came back and everything. So for years, Joseph taught high school… I think he taught art. And in any case, he would take German students to Israel every summer to work on kibbutzes, and it really stayed with him, you know, his…
Was… were they with you? Was Joseph Janik with you on the trip when you went hang-gliding?
